name: feature engine

population_history.note: A prior acceptance attempt populated the immutable core-v1 rows and then failed later in the checker because json_each_text was used on a jsonb column. The final accepted commit changed only the acceptance JSONB iterator after a RED regression test; final acceptance re-read all 104 rows as existing and verified the complete data-integrity gate set.

acceptance_incidents.cause: Compact market_state_1s selection filtered bucket_at but not last_event_at at query time, allowing a same-second row containing a future sub-second event to be selected before the fail-closed guard raised FeatureLeakageError.
acceptance_incidents.resolution: Added RED regression coverage and required last_event_at <= feature_at in the source query while retaining post-selection leakage guards.

acceptance_incidents.cause: The host acceptance checker called json_each_text on jsonb source_cutoffs and PostgreSQL rejected the function signature.
acceptance_incidents.resolution: Added RED regression coverage and changed the checker to jsonb_each_text. Feature rows were not rewritten.

feature_contract.timestamp_policy: Only observations provably available at or before feature_at are eligible.
feature_contract.compact_state_policy: Both bucket_at and last_event_at must be <= feature_at; stale state is explicit rather than treated as current.
feature_contract.candle_policy: Coinbase candles must be fully closed by feature_at.
feature_contract.trade_flow_policy: Raw trade flow uses only the trailing 60-second window and is missing when known exclusions or unproven feed coverage overlap it.
feature_contract.historical_l2_policy: Unavailable/unverified historical Polymarket L2 is not synthesized.
feature_contract.official_reference_policy: official_reference_distance remains NULL and official_reference_missing=true in core-v1.
feature_contract.label_leakage_policy: Official outcome, label reference, resolution, and label provenance fields are not feature inputs.
feature_contract.rerun_policy: Identical natural-key reruns are existing/no-op; changed semantics at the same key fail closed.

downstream_constraints: Phase 3 raw-data exclusions remain binding when Phase 7 constructs raw-dependent datasets.
Phase 4 source-availability limitations remain explicit and must not be imputed as observed data.
Phase 5 official labels may be joined only as targets after feature-time rows are frozen; label outcome/reference/provenance fields must not enter features.
Phase 7 must use leakage-safe train/validation/test splitting appropriate for time-ordered market data and report calibration, coverage, accuracy, and profitability-oriented metrics.
Live prediction, paper trading, and live trading remain blocked by later phase gates.
